probeSources.native-run.sh:
set -eu
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq pulseaudio pulseaudio-utils >/dev/null
mkdir -p /probe/native-out
pulseaudio --system -n --disallow-exit --exit-idle-time=-1 --log-level=debug --log-time=1 --log-target=file:/probe/native-out/pulse.log --load="module-native-protocol-unix auth-anonymous=1 socket=/tmp/pa.sock" -D
export PULSE_SERVER=unix:/tmp/pa.sock PULSE_SOURCE=lunar.monitor
node /probe/null-sink-probe.mjs > /probe/native-out/console.log
chown -R "$(stat -c %u:%g /probe)" /probe/native-out
probeSources.cold-run.sh:
set -eu
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq pulseaudio pulseaudio-utils >/dev/null
mkdir -p /probe/cold-out
pulseaudio --system -n --disallow-exit --exit-idle-time=-1 --log-level=debug --log-time=1 --log-target=file:/probe/cold-out/pulse.log --load="module-native-protocol-unix auth-anonymous=1 socket=/tmp/pa.sock" -D
export PULSE_SERVER=unix:/tmp/pa.sock PULSE_SOURCE=lunar.monitor PLAYWRIGHT_DIR=/pw BROWSER=webkit
for i in 1 2; do
  if [ "$i" = 1 ]; then cp /probe/worklet-original.js /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js; else cp /probe/worklet-marked.js /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js; fi
  for mode in default norewinds; do
    dir=/probe/cold-out/$mode-$i
    mkdir -p "$dir"
    RESET_SINK=$mode timeout 45 node /probe/sim/web/test/cold-probe.mjs /probe/sim/web/www "$dir" > "$dir/browser.log" 2>&1 || echo $? > "$dir/exit-status"
  done
done
cp /probe/worklet-original.js /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js
chown -R "$(stat -c %u:%g /probe)" /probe/cold-out
probeSources.exact-run.sh:
set -eu
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq pulseaudio pulseaudio-utils >/dev/null
mkdir -p /probe/exact-out
pulseaudio --system -n --disallow-exit --exit-idle-time=-1 --log-level=debug --log-target=file:/probe/exact-out/pulse.log --load="module-null-sink sink_name=lunar rate=48000 channels=2" --load="module-native-protocol-unix auth-anonymous=1 socket=/tmp/pa.sock" -D
export PULSE_SERVER=unix:/tmp/pa.sock PULSE_SOURCE=lunar.monitor PLAYWRIGHT_DIR=/pw BROWSER=webkit
pactl --format=json list sinks > /probe/exact-out/sinks-before.json
cp /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js /probe/worklet-original.js
DEBUG=pw:browser timeout 120 node /probe/sim/web/test/audio-loopback.mjs /probe/sim/web/www /probe/exact-out/audio 30 > /probe/exact-out/audio.log 2>&1
for mode in default norewinds; do
  if [ "$mode" = norewinds ]; then
    id=$(pactl list short modules | awk '$2 == "module-null-sink" {print $1}')
    pactl unload-module "$id"
    pactl load-module module-null-sink sink_name=lunar rate=48000 channels=2 norewinds=1 > /probe/exact-out/norewinds-module.txt
    pactl --format=json list sinks > /probe/exact-out/sinks-norewinds.json
  fi
  for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
    dir=/probe/exact-out/$mode-$i
    mkdir -p "$dir"
    if [ "$i" -le 3 ]; then cp /probe/worklet-original.js /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js; else cp /probe/worklet-marked.js /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js; fi
    date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%N > "$dir/times.log"
    DEBUG=pw:browser GST_DEBUG=webkitaudiodestination:4,pulse:3,audiobasesink:3 GST_DEBUG_FILE="$dir/gstreamer.log" timeout 45 node /probe/sim/web/test/startup-probe.mjs /probe/sim/web/www "$dir" > "$dir/browser.log" 2>&1 || echo $? > "$dir/exit-status"
    date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%N >> "$dir/times.log"
  done
done
cp /probe/worklet-original.js /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js
chown -R "$(stat -c %u:%g /probe)" /probe/exact-out
probeSources.acceptance-run.sh:
set -eu
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq pulseaudio pulseaudio-utils >/dev/null
mkdir -p /probe/acceptance-out
pulseaudio --system -n --disallow-exit --exit-idle-time=-1 --log-level=info --log-target=file:/probe/acceptance-out/pulse.log --load="module-native-protocol-unix auth-anonymous=1 socket=/tmp/pa.sock" -D
export PULSE_SERVER=unix:/tmp/pa.sock PULSE_SOURCE=lunar.monitor PLAYWRIGHT_DIR=/pw BROWSER=webkit
cp /probe/worklet-original.js /probe/sim/web/www/worklet.js
for i in 1 2 3; do
 for mode in default norewinds; do
  dir=/probe/acceptance-out/cold-$mode-$i
  mkdir -p "$dir"
  RESET_SINK=$mode timeout 45 node /probe/sim/web/test/cold-probe.mjs /probe/sim/web/www "$dir" > "$dir/browser.log" 2>&1 || echo $? > "$dir/exit-status"
 done
done
pactl --format=json list sinks > /probe/acceptance-out/sinks.json
status=0
for browser in chromium firefox webkit; do
 export BROWSER=$browser
 dir=/probe/acceptance-out/$browser
 mkdir -p "$dir"
 timeout 120 node /probe/sim/web/test/audio-loopback.mjs /probe/sim/web/www "$dir/audio" 30 > "$dir/audio.log" 2>&1 || { echo $? > "$dir/audio-exit-status"; status=1; }
 timeout 180 node /probe/sim/web/test/editor-ui.mjs /probe/sim/web/www "$dir/ui" > "$dir/ui.log" 2>&1 || { echo $? > "$dir/ui-exit-status"; status=1; }
done
chown -R "$(stat -c %u:%g /probe)" /probe/acceptance-out
exit $status
